body: Moved from docs/tasks/P1-instant-play-and-worst-bugs.md on 6 Nov 2026 (the task files hold the definition only; how far a task is lives on the board). **Status 2026-11-01, in the new server (`encore_server`):** random spacing of background look-ups is built (`sources/youtube/pace.py`: a gap of 6 to 18 s, 12 s on average, `ENCORE_YOUTUBE_PACE_S`) and so is the doubling rest after a refusal (`sources/youtube/rest.py`: 30 minutes up to a day). The hourly cap (â‰¤ 120 per hour) is **not built** there; only the older fetch service has an hourly import budget (`IMPORT_MAX_PER_HOUR`, default 120).
